_comment: Copy to speaker.config.json (gitignored) and adjust as needed. Shared settings applied to every Provision-ISR IP speaker (one speaker at a time — no per-device inputs).
_comment_detection: The speaker arrives on DHCP, so there is no fixed factory IP: the tool sweeps these subnets for a host answering HTTP whose landing page is the speaker's (<title>IP Speaker</title>). http_port is the device's web port (80 unless changed). For a dev port-forward, run the CLI with --host 127.0.0.1:8080 instead of scanning.
_comment_pw: Factory login is admin/123456; the tool changes it to new_password. A re-run of an already-configured speaker falls back to new_password automatically.
_comment_ntp: timezone is the device's own encoding: 720 + the UTC offset in minutes (840 = GMT+2 Israel standard, 900 = GMT+3). interval is the NTP poll interval the web UI uses (minutes).
_comment_media: The media file (.mp3/.wav) uploaded to user slot media_slot (0-9). Relative paths resolve against this config/ folder — drop the file into config/media/. The device has only ~4 MB free for user files.
_comment_static: The speaker moves to this static IP as the LAST step (the connection drops; the tool reconnects on the new address and renews the bench PC's DHCP lease). ip_move_timeout: seconds to wait for it to answer there.
